Marks such as "Sela", "τʼ ἀμφιβόλως" and "ver-sæ" are read as best possible and should be checked against the scan. Some Greek and Hebrew words (Hebraicę, Osanna) are transcribed as Latin-letter words as printed. The Greek "τʼ ἀμφιβόλως" is uncertain and should be verified. The "ad Marcellam"/"Pammachium" headings are not headings: they are running list items within the text. The text ends mid-word on the right page ("dē"), and the left page ends mid-word ("Gen,"), as printed. No signature or catchword is clearly visible.
